accepted_scope: All stated shift-controlled scalar affine-fibre cellular automata over every finite field and finite nonempty control alphabet, with arbitrary finite-range c,d.
accepted_conclusions: J_k(F)=sum_(a in B^k) q^(k-r(a)), independent of d.
r(a)<=(q-1)p^(v_p(k)), with p the field characteristic.
Ordinary limit sq for nonconstant one-site c; exact constant-coefficient liminf s*q^(1-1/D) and limsup sq.
supplementary_audit_result: The uniform q-1 multiplicity constant is sharp; its algebraic argument is retained.
outside_scope: Other control evolutions without the proved fixed-fibre reduction.
